title: melicope cucullata var. robustior
intro: Melicope cucullata var. robustior, commonly known as the robust greater nettle tree, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is a shrub or small tree that is native to the Pacific Islands. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Melicope cucullata var. robustior include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
